written.headline: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model with 15-second clips
written.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a generative video model that creates native 15‑second clips and supports multi‑turn conversational editing. The model is priced at $0.07 per second for 720p video, a 30% cost reduction from the prior version.
